# Hardened Ops Agent

> An n8n email agent for production inboxes, hardened against prompt injection. It reads incoming Gmail and does one of four things: opens a GitHub ticket, drafts a reply that a person approves in Telegram, escalates to a person, or quarantines the email. An email cannot make it send, leak or forward anything. Every decision is logged in PostgreSQL. It is red-teamed against Microsoft's LLMail-Inject corpus: 0 of 100 attacks executed, and 0 of 100 ordinary emails quarantined.

Built with n8n (queue mode), Claude Haiku (guard and judge), Claude Sonnet (agent), the Document Guard static scanner node, PostgreSQL and Telegram. MIT license. The project is a workflow you import into your own n8n; it is not a hosted service.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, how it works, results, quick start
- [Setup](docs/SETUP.md): requirements, credentials, placeholders, step-by-step install
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for an AI agent asked to install or verify this project
- [Red-team report](docs/REDTEAM.md): method, sample, per-layer results, run files, how to reproduce
- [Hardening log](docs/HARDENING.md): weaknesses found, evidence, fixes
- [Limitations](docs/LIMITATIONS.md): what the results do not cover yet

## Files

- [workflow/hardened-ops-agent.json](workflow/hardened-ops-agent.json): the main workflow, with eight checkpoints (canonicalize, claim and pre-filter, static guard, LLM guard, agent, output filter, judge, human approval)
- [workflow/inbox-fanout.json](workflow/inbox-fanout.json): polls Gmail and starts one run of the main workflow per email
- [workflow/schema.sql](workflow/schema.sql): the `agent_runs` audit table
- [redteam/](redteam/): seeded sample, runner, four regression checks, report query, run results (`npm run attack`, `npm run checks`)

## Optional

- [LLMail-Inject](https://github.com/microsoft/llmail-inject-challenge): the public attack corpus used for testing
- [n8n docs](https://docs.n8n.io/): installing and running n8n
